description: This file defines a web page containing a visual demo of dynamic layering of colored canvas elements and control buttons for manipulating their z-order. It uses the Isomorphic SmartClient JavaScript framework to create interactive, draggable widgets and buttons.

methods.name: Canvas.create
methods.description: Creates a draggable, colored rectangle widget on the page, representing a canvas element with specified properties.

methods.name: Button.create
methods.description: Creates a button widget with specified label and click handler to manipulate other widgets.
